outsideTests.title: Live run of the two AI readers through `node cli/sheet.js --paste` (21 Nov 2026)

items.text: First attempt without `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`: all 4 messages failed with "The API could not be reached (network or timeout)". Node's built-in fetch ignores the proxy unless told to. 0 requests reached the API, no cost. The failure was handled as designed: each failed message got one NOT READ row for a person.

Second attempt, with the proxy setting: "Read live: 4 of the 6 messages (H031, H036, U001, new-1) ... No reader failure." The two example messages 66 and 72 were replayed from recorded answers, as designed.
Cost reported by the API's usage: **$0.0911 for 8 requests** (2 per message). Wall time 76.8 s.

Live against recorded answers, row by row (Case, Proof cell, proposal): H031 5 of 5 rows identical, H036 3 of 3 identical (the HOLD on Caldmere's process change), U001 1 of 1 identical (handed to a person because the readers disagreed). 9 of 9 rows equal.

new-1 ("Room C stays as confirmed for June 11. Nothing else has changed."), which has no recorded answer: read live and marked REPEAT for Hearings I on AX-123 and AX-124 ("the same statement as message 67: type nothing"), with the words quoted. Checked against messages 67 and 70: correct, nothing new is stated.
Output: 23 rows (live) against 22 (recorded; new-1 NOT READ). Files: `paste-live-21nov.tsv`, `paste-recorded-21nov.tsv` in this folder.
Four messages test the live path, not accuracy. Accuracy is measured on the labelled sets: 72 of 79 recorded and 73 of 81 live on unseen set 2 (docs/evaluation/live-readers-22nov.md).
The readers still know only the 24 packet hearings; the firm's own rows are not connected. No mailbox was read.
Behind a proxy, Node needs `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1` (Node 22.21 or newer). The prototype README should say so next to the --paste command.
